1600.meaningLit: discourse on the soul is one thing, the body is another
1600.sanskrit: anya + jīva + anya + śarīra + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

1601.meaning1: gnosis; spiritual insight; awakening; final knowledge

examples.text: katame satta phalā satt'ānisaṃsā? diṭṭh'eva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti. no ce diṭṭh'eva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti, atha maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti.
jhāyiṃ virajam'āsīnaṃ, katakiccaṃ anāsavaṃ, pāraguṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūhi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.

1602.grammar: fem, abstr, dat sg of aññā, irreg form of aññāya
1602.meaning1: to gnosis; to spiritual insight; to awakening; to final knowledge
1602.construction:
ā + √ñā + ā + āya
aññā + āya > annā

examples.text: tassa sāvakā na sussūsanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, vokkamma ca satthusāsanā vattanti.

1603.grammar: fem, abstr, dat sg of aññā, irreg form of aññāya
1603.construction:
ā + √ñā + ā + āya
aññā + āya > annā

examples.text: ye te sutt'antā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīr'atthā lok'uttarā suññatappaṭisaṃyuttā, tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti na sotaṃ odahissanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti

1604.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in long standing; the Buddha's first monastic disciple; first person to realize the Buddha's teaching
1604.notes: Theragāthā verses 673-688 (TH15.1, TH246) are attributed to him.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā aññākoṇḍañño sucirass'eva yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavato pādāni mukhena ca paricumbati, pāṇīhi ca parisambāhati, nāmañ'ca sāveti, koṇḍañño'haṃ, bhagavā, koṇḍañño'haṃ, sugatā'ti.

1605.meaning1: intention to understand; intention for spiritual insight
1605.meaning2: thought for knowledge, intention of gaining perfect knowledge

examples.text: yadā aññāsi sandhāno gahapati, añña'd'atthu kho dān'ime aññatitthiyā paribbājakā bhagavato bhāsitaṃ sussūsanti, sotaṃ odahanti, aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpentī'ti.

1606.grammar: nt, act, from na jānāti, neg (+loc)
1606.meaning1: ignorance (of); lack of understanding (of); not knowing (about)

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, avijjā? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ.
byāpādavitakko, bhikkhave, andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.

atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, sabbe'p'ime moghapurisā phuṭṭhā pāpimatā. yatra hi nāma ekassa'pi na evaṃ bhavissati, handa mayaṃ aññāṇ'attham'pi samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ carāma, kiṃ karissati satt'āho'ti?

1608.meaning1: ignorance (of); lack of understanding (of); not knowing (about)
1608.construction:
na > a + √ñā + aṇa + ka
aññāṇa + ka

examples.text: tañ'ce bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā bhikkhunā dvattikkhattuṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne, ko pana vādo bhiyyo, na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi
evaṃ vadeyyā'ti anācāraṃ ācaritvā, aññāṇakena āpanno'ti jānantū'ti pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeti, idān'eva kho ahaṃ jānāmi

1609.meaning1: which causes ignorance; which creates a lack of understanding

examples.text: byāpādavitakko, bhikkhave, andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.

1610.grammar: nt, abstr, from na ñāṇa, neg
1610.construction:
na > a + √ñā + aṇa + tta
aññāṇa + tta

1611.meaning1: even for the sake of finding out about; even for the benefit of understanding; for the sake of arahantship

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, sabbe'p'ime moghapurisā phuṭṭhā pāpimatā. yatra hi nāma ekassa'pi na evaṃ bhavissati, handa mayaṃ aññāṇ'attham'pi samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ carāma, kiṃ karissati satt'āho'ti?

1612.meaning1: unpleasant when not known; painful while not known

examples.text: sukhā kho, āvuso visākha, vedanā ṭhitisukhā vipariṇāmadukkhā. dukkhā vedanā ṭhitidukkhā vipariṇāmasukhā. adukkham'asukhā vedanā ñāṇasukhā aññāṇadukkhā'ti.

1613.meaning1: failed to understand; did not understand

examples.text: tena hi, bho gotama, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti iti puṭṭho samāno n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti kho, vaccha, na upetī'ti vadesi. etth'āhaṃ, bho gotama, aññāṇam'āpādiṃ, ettha sammoham'āpādiṃ.

1614.meaning1: born from the root of ignorance; sprung from the source of not knowing

examples.text: yā kāci kaṅkhā abhinandanā vā, anekadhātūsu puthū sadāsitā, aññāṇamūlappabhavā pajappitā, sabbā mayā byantikatā samūlikā.
yesañ'h'etaṃ, sāriputta, aññātaṃ assa adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ aphassitaṃ paññāya te tattha paresaṃ saddhāya gaccheyyuṃ
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷh'uddhāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ chadvāraṃ. tatr'assa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī, aññātānaṃ nivāretā, ñātānaṃ pavesetā.

1617.synonym: anubodha, abhiññāta, upaññāta, jānita, ñāta, viññāta, vidita

examples.text: aññātam'etaṃ vacanaṃ, asitassa yathātathaṃ, taṃ taṃ gotama pucchāmi, sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ.
yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, anuseti taṃ anumīyati, yaṃ anumīyati tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati. yaṃ n'ānuseti na taṃ anumīyati, yaṃ n'ānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatī'ti. aññātaṃ, bhagavā, aññātaṃ, sugatā'ti.

1618.construction:
na > a + √ñā + ta + ka
aññāta + ka
1618.commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.4) aññātikā nāma mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddhā.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā ākoṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
bhikkhuṃ pan'eva uddissa aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya

1619.construction:
na > a + √ñā + ta + ka
aññāta + ka

examples.text: maddarājā cintesi sac'āhaṃ imaṃ ekassa dassāmi, sesarājāno kujjhissanti, mama dhītaraṃ rakkhissāmī'ti dhītarañ'ca bhariyañ'ca gahetvā aññātakavesena palāyitvā araññaṃ pavisitvā cūḷakāliṅgakumārassa assamapadato uparibhāge assamaṃ katvā pabbajitvā uñchācariyāya jīvikaṃ kappento tattha paṭivasati.

1620.meaning1: perceiving as unrelated; regarding (someone) as not a relative

examples.text: aññātake aññātakasaññī, aññatra samayā, cīvaraṃ viññāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. aññātake vematiko, aññatra samayā, cīvaraṃ viññāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

1621.meaning1: rule about asking unrelated people; Nissaggiya 6

1622.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of aññātakavesa

examples.text: maddarājā cintesi sac'āhaṃ imaṃ ekassa dassāmi, sesarājāno kujjhissanti, mama dhītaraṃ rakkhissāmī'ti dhītarañ'ca bhariyañ'ca gahetvā aññātakavesena palāyitvā araññaṃ pavisitvā cūḷakāliṅgakumārassa assamapadato uparibhāge assamaṃ katvā pabbajitvā uñchācariyāya jīvikaṃ kappento tattha paṭivasati.

1623.meaning1: for the sake of understanding; for the purpose of knowledge

examples.text: aññāt'atthaṃ pasād'atthaṃ, sataṃ ve hoti mantanā, evaṃ kho ariyā mantenti, esā ariyāna mantanā, etadaññāya medhāvī, na samusseyya mantaye'ti.

1624.meaning1: should be understood; to be known (by)

examples.text: sikkhamānena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā aññātabbaṃ paripucchitabbaṃ paripañhitabbaṃ, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
makkhī dhammaṃ suṇāti makkhapariyuṭṭhito, upārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti randhagavesī, dhammadesake āhatacitto hoti khīlajāto, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.
saṃkhittena'pi kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, vitthārena'pi kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, saṃkhittavitthārena'pi kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, aññātāro ca dullabhā'ti.
uṭṭhehi vīra vijitasaṅgāma, satthavāha aṇaṇa vicara loke, desassu bhagavā dhammaṃ, aññātāro bhavissantī'ti.

1627.meaning1: (in debate) assertion about what is known
1627.commentary: (ANa) aññātavāde saṇṭhātī'ti imaṃ pañhaṃ pucchitvā, suṭṭhu te pañho pucchito, pucchantena nāma evaṃ pucchitabban'ti vutte sampaṭicchati, vimatiṃ na uppādeti. pañhaṃ kathetvā'pi, suṭṭhu te pañho kathito, kathentena nāma evaṃ kathetabban'ti vutte sampaṭicchati, vimatiṃ na uppādeti.

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhāti parikappe na saṇṭhāti aññātavāde na saṇṭhāti paṭipadāya na saṇṭhāti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

1628.meaning1: faculty of one who is awakened

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. katamāni tīṇi? anaññātañ'ñassāmī't'indriyaṃ, aññ'indriyaṃ, aññātāv'indriyaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi indriyānī'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca. tatth'etaṃ iti vuccati.
saddh'indriyaṃ, viriy'indriyaṃ, sat'indriyaṃ, samādh'indriyaṃ, paññ'indriyaṃ, anaññātañ'ñassāmī't'indriyaṃ, aññ'indriyaṃ, aññātāv'indriyaṃ.

1629.meaning2: in disguise; not in one's own form

1630.meaning1: who is awakened; who has final knowledge; who possesses perfect knowledge
1630.commentary: (DNa) aññ'indriyan'ti aññābhūtaṃ ājānanabhūtaṃ indriyaṃ. sot'āpattiphalato paṭṭhāya chasu ṭhānesu ñāṇass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. aññātāv'indriyan'ti aññātāvīsu jānanakiccapariyosānappattesu dhammesu indriyaṃ. arahattaphalañāṇass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. katamāni tīṇi? anaññātañ'ñassāmī't'indriyaṃ, aññ'indriyaṃ, aññātāv'indriyaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi indriyānī'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca. tatth'etaṃ iti vuccati.
saddh'indriyaṃ, viriy'indriyaṃ, sat'indriyaṃ, samādh'indriyaṃ, paññ'indriyaṃ, anaññātañ'ñassāmī't'indriyaṃ, aññ'indriyaṃ, aññātāv'indriyaṃ.

1631.synonym: avabujjhati, aveti, ājānāti, jānāti, paccabyati, pajānāti, bujjhati, munāti, vijānāti, vedeti, sampajānāti
1631.commentary: (THa) na hi tvaṃ, kappaṭa, mattam'aññāsī'ti tvaṃ, kappaṭa, saṅghamajjhamhi pacalāyamāno mattaṃ pamāṇaṃ na vā maññasi

examples.text: atha kho, pāpima, kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nāg'āpalokitaṃ apalokesi, na v'āyaṃ dūsī māro mattam'aññāsī'ti. sah'āpalokanāya ca pana, pāpima, dūsī māro tamhā ca ṭhānā cavi mahānirayañ'ca upapajji.

1632.meaning1: perceiving as unrelated; regarding (someone) as not a relative

examples.text: aññātikāya aññātikasaññī purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeti ākoṭāpeti, nissaggiyena āpatti dukkaṭassa.

1633.grammar: adj, fem nom sg of aññātaka, neg
1633.construction:
na > a + √ñā + ta + ka + ikā
aññātaka + ikā
1633.commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.4) aññātikā nāma mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddhā.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā purāṇacīvaraṃ dhovāpeyya vā rajāpeyya vā ākoṭāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya aññatra pārivattakā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

1634.meaning1: wishing to know; wanting to understand

examples.text: mandattā momūhattā paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, paribhavaṃ paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, aññātu'kāmo paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati

1635.commentary: (SNa) aññāt'uñchenā'ti abhilakkhitesu issarajanagehesu kaṭukabhaṇḍasambhāraṃ sugandhaṃ bhojanaṃ pariyesantassa uñcho ñāt'uñcho nāma. gharapaṭipāṭiyā pana dvāre ṭhitena laddhaṃ missakabhojanaṃ aññāt'uñcho nāma. ayam'idha adhippeto.

examples.text: kad'āhaṃ nandaṃ passeyyaṃ, āraññaṃ paṃsukūlikaṃ, aññāt'uñchena yāpentaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinan'ti.
mandattā momūhattā paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, paribhavaṃ paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati, aññātu'kāmo paraṃ pañhaṃ pucchati
dūrato'pi kho mayaṃ, āvuso, āgaccheyyāma āyasmato sāriputtassa santike etassa bhāsitassa attham'aññātuṃ

1637.meaning1: otherwise; of another kind; different; not like that

examples.text: kacci, tāta uttara, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā santaṃ'y'eva saddo abbhuggato, no aññathā? kacci pana so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso, no aññādiso'ti?

1638.meaning1: breakthrough to spiritual insight; penetration to awakening

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, yāvatā saññāsamāpatti tāvatā aññāpaṭivedho.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā, na āyataken'eva aññāpaṭivedho

1639.meaning2: seeking gnosis; looking for spiritual insight

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci maṃ subhaddo pucchissati, sabbaṃ taṃ aññ'āpekkho'va pucchissati, no vihes'āpekkho. yaṃ c'ass'āhaṃ puṭṭho byākarissāmi, taṃ khippam'eva ājānissatī'ti.

1640.meaning1: fruit of gnosis; result of awakening
1640.commentary: (ANa) aññāphalo vutto'ti aññā vuccati arahattaṃ, arahattaphalasamādhi nām'eso vutto bhagavatā'ti attho.

examples.text: y'āyaṃ, bhagini, samādhi na c'ābhinato na c'āpanato na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato, vimuttattā ṭhito, ṭhitattā santusito, santusitattā no paritassati, ayaṃ, bhagini, samādhi aññāphalo vutto bhagavatā'ti.

1641.meaning1: declaring awakening; asserting gnosis; stating one's enlightenment

examples.text: pañc'imāni, bhikkhave, aññābyākaraṇāni. katamāni pañca?
etañ'hi tumhe paṭipannā, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatha, akkhāto vo mayā maggo, aññāya sallakantanaṃ.
etadaññāya ye satā, diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā, upasantā ca te sadā, tiṇṇā loke visattikan'ti.

1643.meaning1: by gnosis; with spiritual insight; by awakening

examples.text: yass'ālayā na vijjanti, aññāya akathaṃkathī, amat'ogadham'anuppattaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

1644.meaning1: peace of gnosis; calm of awakening

examples.text: ye ca phassaṃ pariññāya, aññāy'upasame ratā, te ve phass'ābhisamayā, nicchātā parinibbutā'ti.

1645.meaning1: attaining final knowledge; accomplishing spiritual insight
1645.meaning2: attainment of final knowledge; accomplishment in spiritual insight

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā aññ'ārādhanā hoti?
yaṃ me kaṅkhitam'aññāsi, vicikicchā maṃ tārayi namo te, muni monapathesu pattipatta, akhila ādiccabandhu sorato'si.
atha kho bhagavā imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi, aññāsi vata bho koṇḍañño, aññāsi vata bho koṇḍañño'ti!

1647.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in long standing; the Buddha's first monastic disciple; first person to realize the Buddha's teaching
1647.commentary: (SNa) aññāsikoṇḍañño'ti paṭhamaṃ dhammassa aññātattā evaṃ gahitanāmo thero.
1647.notes: Theragāthā verses 673-688 (TH15.1, TH246) are attributed to him.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā aññāsikoṇḍañño sucirass'eva yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavato pādāni mukhena ca paricumbati, pāṇīhi ca parisambāhati, nāmañ'ca sāveti
aññāsi vata, bho, koṇḍañño, aññāsi vata, bho, koṇḍañño'ti! iti h'idaṃ āyasmato koṇḍaññassa aññāsikoṇḍañño' tv'eva nāmaṃ ahosī'ti.

1650.meaning1: just one thing; just another thing

examples.text: bhavanirodho nibbānaṃ bhavanirodho nibbānan'ti kho me, āvuso, aññā'va saññā uppajjati aññā'va saññā nirujjhati. seyyathā'pi, āvuso, sakalik'aggissa jhāyamānassa aññā'va acci uppajjati aññā'va acci nirujjhati

1652.meaning1: freed by gnosis; liberated through spiritual insight

examples.text: tato aññāvimuttassa, ñāṇaṃ ve hoti tādino, akuppā me vimuttī'ti, bhavasaṃyojanakkhaye'ti.

1653.meaning1: freedom by gnosis; liberation through spiritual insight

examples.text: tato aññāvimuttiyā, ñāṇañ'ca hoti tādino, akuppā me vimuttī'ti, bhavasaṃyojanakkhaye'ti.

1654.meaning1: liberation through spiritual insight; release by gnosis; freedom through understanding
1654.commentary: (ANa) aññāvimokkhan'ti aññ'indriyapariyosāne uppannaṃ vimokkhaṃ, aññāya vā vimokkhaṃ aññāvimokkhaṃ, paññāvimuttan'ti attho.

examples.text: jhāyiṃ virajam'āsīnaṃ, katakiccaṃ anāsavaṃ, pāraguṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūhi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.
upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhaṃ, dhammatakkapurejavaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūmi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.

1656.meaning1: faculty of awakening; power of final knowledge

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. katamāni tīṇi? anaññātañ'ñassāmī't'indriyaṃ, aññ'indriyaṃ, aññātāv'indriyaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi indriyānī'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca. tatth'etaṃ iti vuccati.
saddh'indriyaṃ, viriy'indriyaṃ, sat'indriyaṃ, samādh'indriyaṃ, paññ'indriyaṃ, anaññātañ'ñassāmī't'indriyaṃ, aññ'indriyaṃ, aññātāv'indriyaṃ.

1657.meaningLit: discourse on the faculty of awakening

1658.grammar: pron, fem instr sg of añña

1661.commentary: (MNa) aññen'aññaṃ paṭicaratī'ti aññena kāraṇena vacanena vā aññaṃ kāraṇaṃ vacanaṃ vā paṭicchādeti. āpattiṃ āpanno'sī'ti vutte ko āpanno, kiṃ āpanno, kismiṃ āpanno, kaṃ bhaṇatha, kiṃ bhaṇathā'ti vā vadati. evarūpaṃ kiñci tayā diṭṭhan'ti vutte na suṇāmī'ti sotaṃ vā upaneti.

examples.text: so bhikkhūhi vuccamāno aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti, na sammā vattati, na lomaṃ pāteti, na netthāraṃ vattati, yena saṅgho attamano hoti taṃ karomī'ti n'āha.

1662.commentary: (VINa) īdisaṃ tayā kiñci diṭṭhan'ti puṭṭho, na suṇāmī'ti sotam'upanento vā, sotadvāre pucchantānaṃ cakkhuṃ upanento vā, aññen'aññaṃ paṭicaratī'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.
